title: Cosmic Druid Magic
description: A hooded figure in a flowing green robe stands with both hands raised, channeling glowing green magical vines and leaves that swirl around them. Above, several large dark birds fly through a vibrant cosmic sky filled with nebulae, stars, and swirling purple and green clouds, while a dark reflective body of water sits below twisted ancient trees.
prompt: A hooded druid in a flowing dark green robe stands with arms raised high, summoning glowing green magical vines and leaves that spiral around their body. Several large dark birds soar through a vibrant cosmic nebula sky filled with purple, teal and green clouds and sparkling stars. Twisted ancient trees frame the scene, with a dark reflective cosmic lake below, in a surreal fantasy style with luminous details and magical atmosphere.
